Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: The logon message authenticates a user establishing a connection to a remote system. Must always be initiated by Member to IEX.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds. Low values (e.g., 30) are recommended.

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: The Heartbeat monitors the status of the communication link and identifies when the last of a string of messages was not received.

Message.Name: TestRequest
Message.Description: The test request message forces a heartbeat from the opposing application.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message.

Message.Name: ResendRequest
Message.Description: The resend request is sent by the receiving application to initiate the retransmission of messages. Utilized if a sequence number gap is detected, if the receiving application lost a message, or as a function of the initialization process.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent. If request is for a single message BeginSeqNo = EndSeqNo. If request is for all messages subsequent to a particular message, EndSeqNo = 0 (representing infinity).

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: The reject message should be issued when a message is received but cannot be properly processed due to a session-level rule violation.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text describing reject reason.

Message.Name: SequenceReset
Message.Description: The sequence reset message is used by the sending application to reset the incoming sequence number on the opposing side.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: Next sequence number to expect.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent. Y=Gap Fill Message, MsgSeqNum field valid.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: The logout message initiates or confirms the termination of a FIX session.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text.

Message.Name: NewOrderSingle
Message.Description: The New Order Single message is used by Members to electronically submit orders to IEX for execution

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier, per session, per trading day for Order as assigned by the Member. Max length 20 chars. ASCII characters not permitted: @, comma, double quotation, pipe.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Instructions for order handling. d=Discretionary Peg, f=ISO, i=IEX Only (Standard), j=Discretionary Limit, M=Midpoint Peg, o=Offset Peg, P=Market Peg, Q=Market Maker Peg, R=Primary Peg, u=Router, y=Trade At ISO, z=Corporate D-Peg, 1=Automated execution order.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: Instructions for order handling. Value ignored, if present.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares ordered. 1-10,000,000.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Type of order. 1=Market, 2=Limit, P=Pegged.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required for Limit Orders. The MPV shall be $0.01 for orders priced $1.00 or greater, and $0.0001 for orders priced below $1.00. If price is not specified for pegged orders, will be constrained by internal IEX Order Collar.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: A=Agency, P=Principal, R=Riskless Principal. Option to default on a session level without needing to send per message.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of Order. 1=Buy, 2=Sell Long, 5=Sell Short, 6=Sell Short Exempt.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker Symbol. The entire symbol (root and suffix, if applicable) needs to be sent if using Nasdaq symbology. CMS symbology can be sent either via 55/65 combo or concatenated using 55 alone.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0=Day, 2=At the open, 3=IOC, 4=FOK, 5=Good til Extended Day (GTX), 6=Good til Time (GTT), 7=At the close, M=System Hours (SYS).

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of order creation expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: If sent by Member, this value will be echoed back in execution reports. Max length 16 chars.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free form text. Will not be processed and will not be echoed back on execution reports.

Field.Name: SymbolSfx
Field.Description: Additional information about the security (e.g., preferred, warrants, etc.). Not available for Nasdaq format, available for CMS only.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity size of an order to be executed. Only non-displayed orders (111=0) may have a MinQty. Not compatible with ISO or FOK.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Quantity to display (for a reserve order). If not populated, order is fully displayed. If MaxFloor(111)=0, limit order is non-displayed.

Field.Name: LocateReqd
Field.Description: Required for Sell Short and Sell Short Exempt orders. N=Locate not required. [N] is the only accepted valid value.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Required for GTT orders. Must be today's date with a valid value within the remaining trading time.

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: Signed dollar value added to the price of the peg for a pegged order. Domain of values: [-100.00 ... 100.00].

Field.Name: AntiInternalizationQualifiersAIQID
Field.Description: Anti-Internalization "AIQ" identifier. 3 Characters for self trade prevention: first 2 characters are the AIQ identifier, 3rd character is the AIQ modifier (N=Cancel newest, O=Cancel oldest, B=Cancel both, S=Cancel smaller, D=Decrement Larger).

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: Quantity range to display (for a reserve order). Must be accompanied with a MaxFloor (111) if DisplayRange (8020) is populated.

Field.Name: InvestorID
Field.Description: Unique string per investor on whose behalf the Member is acting. Will not be echoed back on execution reports. Max length 20 chars.

Field.Name: ExtendedExecInst
Field.Description: R=Retail, T=Retail Liquidity Provider (RLP). Only applies to Retail orders and Retail Liquidity Provider orders.

Field.Name: MinQtyInstruction
Field.Description: C=Composite, M=Minimum Execution Size with Cancel Remaining, A=Minimum Execution Size with AON Remaining. Only valid if 110 (MinQty) is sent.

Message.Name: OrderCancelRequest
Message.Description: Cancel request for a previously submitted order. The IEX OrderID (37) need not be referenced, as IEX will validate the order using ClOrdID (11) and OrigClOrdID (41).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of cancel request.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Must match original order quantity.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID referencing the order to be cancelled.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Must match original side.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Must match original symbol.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of cancel creation expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: SymbolSfx
Field.Description: Must match original SymbolSfx, if applicable.

Message.Name: OrderCancelReplaceRequest
Message.Description: The only amendable properties of IEX orders are: OrderQty (38), Price (44) for Peg and Limit orders, MinQty (110), Account (1), PegDifference (211). The IEX OrderID (37) need not be referenced, as IEX will validate the order using ClOrdID (11) and OrigClOrdID (41). All required FIX tags/values from original order need to be preserved and resent in the Cancel/Replace request.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of cancel/replace request.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Must match original ExecInst.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: Instructions for order handling. Value ignored, if present.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Requested total shares for order to be amended to. Cannot be less than currently executed quantity.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Must match original OrdType.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID referencing the order to be replaced.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Must match original OrderCapacity.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Must match original Side.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Must match original Symbol.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Must match original TimeInForce.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of cancel/replace creation expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Value received will overwrite Account value from original order. If original order was received with an Account value, and 35=G is sent without the Account tag, tag 1 will not be echoed back for the rest of the order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Requested price for the order to be amended to.

Field.Name: SymbolSfx
Field.Description: Must match original SymbolSfx, if applicable.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: If MinQty tag is not present IEX will preserve original value for the order (no change to MinQty). MinQty=0 will remove the condition from the order altogether.

Field.Name: ExtendedExecInst
Field.Description: T=Retail Liquidity Provider orders. Changes to ExtendedExecInst (9416) are not accepted on RLP orders.

Field.Name: AvgPrice
Field.Description: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Will match confirmed ClOrdID of current order chain.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Total number of shares filled.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of execution message. Case sensitive alpha-numeric free format string.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Will reflect last accepted value.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Referenced ExecID of execution to apply trade correction to.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Identifies transaction type. 0=New, 1=Cancel, A=Pending New.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Market of execution for last fill. 4 character code. See Appendix D.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique IEX Order ID.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Identifies current status of order. 0=New, 1=Partial fill, 2=Fill, 4=Canceled, 5=Replace, 6=Pending Cancel, 8=Rejected, E=Pending Replace.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: OrigTime
Field.Description: Indicates TransactTime (60) of original execution. Applicable for Trade Busts.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Will reflect last accepted value.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution creation (in UTC).

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Present on Drop Copy messages only. 4 Character MPID if original order was sent via Service Bureau session (e.g., ABCD); 4 Character MPID + 3 digit integer representing original SenderCompID if original order was sent via Direct connection (e.g., ABCD001).

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Will reflect expire time of GTT order.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Describes the specific Execution Report (e.g., Pending Cancel) while OrdStatus will always identify the current order status (i.e., Partially Filled). 0=New, 1=Partial fill, 2=Fill, 4=Canceled, 5=Replace, 6=Pending Cancel, 8=Rejected, A=Pending New, D=Restated, E=Pending Replace.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Number of shares open for further execution.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: SymbolSfx
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: SecondaryOrderID
Field.Description: IEX OrderID (FIX Tag 37 of the contra order). New field on AIQ cancel messages which represents the contra side order ID that order would have traded against. Must request opt-in at firm or port level for "Report AIQ Fields" to receive this field. Only present when 150=D.

Field.Name: AntiInternalizationQualifiersAIQID
Field.Description: On an AIQ canceled/restated message, this is what the AIQ qualifiers would have been on the trade. Must request opt-in at firm or port level for "Report AIQ Fields" to receive this field.

Field.Name: ExtendedExecInst
Field.Description: R=Retail, T=Retail Liquidity Provider. Only applies to Retail orders and Retail Liquidity Provider orders.

Field.Name: EffectiveLimitPrice
Field.Description: New effective limit price of the order due to CQI price change. Only sent when ExecInst[18]=j Discretionary Limit.

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: To be used in conjunction with LastMkt(30) to determine trading costs. Base characters: MI=Add Non-Displayed Continuous, ML=Add Displayed Continuous, TI=Remove Non-Displayed Continuous, TL=Remove Displayed Continuous, X=Opening Process, O=Opening Auction, C=Closing Auction, H=Halt/Volatility Auction, P=IPO Auction. Appended characters: S=Internalization, Q=Crumbling Quote, D=Displayed Continuous in cross/auction, R=Retail removes liquidity, A=Member adds liquidity against Retail order with RLP order.

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Specific fee code associated with execution on a non-IEX market. To be used in conjunction with LastMkt(30) to determine trading costs. Passed through value from Market Centers if LastMkt is not IEX.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares executed on this (last) fill.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this (last) fill.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Identifies contra broker (denoted with value "IEXG").

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: The number of ContraBroker (375) entries (denoted with value "1").

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Identifies source of execution and whether an execution on IEX resulted from liquidity provision or removal, or from a single-price cross (e.g., auction). 1=Added Liquidity, 2=Removed Liquidity, 3=Routed, 4=Auction, 9=Removed Liquidity on Recheck.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares executed on this (last) fill.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this (last) fill.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Identifies contra broker (denoted with value "IEXG").

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: The number of ContraBroker (375) entries (denoted with value "1").

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Identifies source of execution and whether an execution on IEX resulted from liquidity provision or removal, or from a single-price cross (e.g., auction). 1=Added Liquidity, 2=Removed Liquidity, 3=Routed, 4=Auction, 9=Removed Liquidity on Recheck.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID used to identify the referenced order in cancel/replace request.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID used to identify the referenced order in cancel/replace request.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for order rejection.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text.

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: 3=Repricing of order, 4=State Change. Only present when 150=D.

Message.Name: OrderCancelReject
Message.Description: Sent in response to a Cancel Request or Cancel/Replace Request that cannot be processed. CxlRejResponseTo (434) identifies the type of request.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Will match cancel or cancel/replace request.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: IEX Order ID, or "NONE" if this is an unknown order to IEX.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: OrdStatus value after this cancel reject is applied.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the referenced order which could not be cancelled or replaced.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for cancel rejection. 0=Too late to cancel, 1=Unknown order, 2=Exchange Option, 3=Already Pending Cancel or Pending Replace.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: Identifies the type of request that a Cancel Reject is in response to. 1=Order Cancel Request, 2=Order Cancel/Replace Request.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Reason for cancel or cancel/replace reject.

Field.Name: SymbolSfx
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Message.Name: IEXTradeBust
Message.Description: IEX currently supports Trade Busts via a custom message type "UCC" that can be enabled at the port level. Trade Busts do not alter live order state.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Will match original execution.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of execution message.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Referenced ExecID of execution to apply trade bust to.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 1=Cancel.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price on the original trade being cancelled.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares on the original trade being cancelled.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Will match original execution.

Field.Name: OrigTime
Field.Description: Indicates TransactTime (60) of original execution.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Will match original execution.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Will match original execution.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of trade bust expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Denoted with value "IEXG".

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Denoted with value "1".

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: SymbolSfx
Field.Description: Will match original order.

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Will match original execution.

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Will match original execution.

Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Identifies beginning of new message and protocol version 4.2. ALWAYS FIRST FIELD IN MESSAGE.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field. ALWAYS SECOND FIELD IN MESSAGE.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Defines message type. ALWAYS THIRD FIELD IN MESSAGE.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: IEX-assigned value used to identify firm sending message.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Members will target "IEXG".

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Integer message sequence number.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC, also known as "GMT"). Higher resolution timestamps (microsecond or nanosecond level granularity) are available on IEX outbound messages and will reflect the User's port-level setting.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: IEX-assigned value used to identify firm sending message. Applicable for Service Bureau connections.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: IEX-assigned value used to identify firm the message is intended for. Applicable for Service Bureau connections.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number. Default: Not sent. Only required for resend messages.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Indicates that message may contain information that has been sent under another sequence number.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Original time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC) when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three byte, simple checksum. ALWAYS LAST FIELD IN MESSAGE; i.e., serves, with the trailing SOH, as the end-of-message delimiter. Always defined as three characters.
